section.p: Consider a procedure for configuring an email where a step contains a list of required inputs.

entry.codeblock: # Configuring an Email Notification 1. Gather the following information: - SMTP server address - Sender email address - Recipient email addresses - Authentication credentials 2. Open the Notification Settings page. 3. Configure the email settings.

Configuring an Email Notification Gather the following information:
  • SMTP server address
  • Sender email address
  • Recipient email addresses
  • Authentication credentials
 Open the Notification Settings page. Configure the email settings.

section.p: Result: The converter creates a DITA task because the numbered list represents a procedure. The nested bullet list is converted into a DITA <ul> and placed inside an <info> element associated with the parent step.
